user_reported_bug: When I try to change thumbnail for an already-uploaded video I get: 'Save failed: Update failed: KeyError: uploader_id'. Also subtitle upload still fails with the same error as before.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification seeded legacy MongoDB video documents without uploader_id plus a normal owned video, then verified PATCH thumbnail updates, multipart .vtt subtitle upload, video deletion, subtitle deletion, and admin/non-admin ownership behavior. All tested legacy-safe ownership paths now return the expected 200/403 responses with no KeyError: uploader_id.
action_items: No fix action needed for the tested reported flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified /app/backend/server.py uses legacy-safe uploader ownership checks in PATCH /api/videos/{id}, POST /api/videos/{id}/subtitles, DELETE /api/videos/{id}, and DELETE /api/videos/{id}/subtitles/{sid}. Runtime API tests confirmed legacy docs without uploader_id are admin-editable/deletable and non-admin denied without 500s.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/test_reports/bug_verification_17.py for the focused regression suite. It covers the previous iteration 16 scenarios plus DELETE legacy video and DELETE legacy subtitle checks.
rca_of_the_issue: Prior crashes came from direct v["uploader_id"] access on migrated legacy video documents. The fixed code now treats missing uploader_id as legacy/admin-only for the affected endpoints; verified by API responses and database persistence/removal checks.
